title: Customer, Glean and partner value
objective: Name one benefit for each party and one accountability boundary.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: A Blueprint should be worth the time for everyone in the room. When each party knows what it gains and what it is accountable for, the engagement moves faster and handoffs stay clean.

items: **The customer** gets business-level alignment and an actionable roadmap: prioritized use cases, current-state evidence, business-aligned metrics, and a group-level business case. The process also builds excitement and sponsorship across business units, which helps secure budget and resources.
**Glean** gets a better-qualified, value-led evaluation with a named sponsor and clear success criteria, rather than an open-ended trial.

**The partner** brings industry knowledge, facilitation skill, and technical context. In return, the Blueprint creates a clear delivery roadmap that can turn discovery into adoption, agent builds, and ongoing optimization.

blocks.x: Partner participation does not transfer commercial approval, product support accountability, or permission to describe capabilities Glean has not confirmed. Agree who owns what before the first session: who facilitates, who takes notes, who answers product feasibility questions, and who owns the follow-up. Glean keeps its own processes for approving pilots and escalating product issues.

blocks.label: Good use of partner expertise
blocks.x: A partner leads a departmental workshop and translates the customer's goals into grounded workflow discovery. The Glean account team supplies product patterns and feasibility guidance. The result is a clearer services scope, not just more workshops.
Each party gets something different from the same engagement. Seeing the three side by side helps you explain it.

blocks.title: What each party gains from a Blueprint
blocks.alt: Three cards. The customer gains clear, prioritized use cases and a defensible business case. Glean gains a qualified opportunity with an executive decision path. The partner gains a services roadmap tied to measured customer outcomes.

items.label: The customer
items.detail: Prioritized use cases and a business case they can defend internally

items.label: Glean
items.detail: A qualified opportunity with sponsorship and a clear validation path

items.label: The partner
items.detail: A services roadmap tied to measured customer outcomes
